prompt.project_info: A cozy playful at-home snapshot with white satin pajamas, teddy bears, warm lamps, and soft flash.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with loose, slightly messy natural bed-head hair and no hair accessories, ribbons, clips, or jewelry. She wears a comfortable white satin pajama shirt-and-shorts set and simple white socks, winking with a playful relaxed expression.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle wide 3:4 portrait from a 28mm lens. She reclines safely on a soft fabric sofa surrounded by teddy bears and plush toys, playfully raising one socked leg toward the camera in foreshortening while her hands make casual framing gestures. Keep the sofa, plush-filled floor, warm lamps, and lived-in bedroom context; no text or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft direct flash mixed with warm lamp ambience creates creamy inviting tones and gentle satin highlights without harshness. Use slightly desaturated Fujifilm Classic Negative-style greens, warm skin tones, soft highlights, and subtle grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 28mm wide lens, high-angle snapshot framing, 3:4 portrait, realistic texture, natural unpolished grain, dynamic perspective, soft contrast.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cozy home lifestyle snapshot of an adult woman with loose slightly messy natural bed-head hair, no hair accessories, winking at camera, wearing a comfortable white satin pajama shirt-and-shorts set and white socks. She reclines safely on a soft fabric sofa in a cute warm bedroom surrounded by teddy bears and plush toys, playfully raising one socked leg toward camera in foreshortening and making casual hand-framing gestures. High-angle 28mm wide-lens view captures the surrounding plushies, warm lamps, lived-in room, soft direct flash mixed with warm ambient lamp light, creamy inviting tone, Fujifilm Classic Negative style, slightly desaturated greens, warm natural skin tones, soft satin highlights, subtle grain, realistic texture, 3:4 portrait, no readable text or logos.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Individual plushies and room details may be replaced.
